description: An operations director must finalize the production sequence and control plan for two customer orders sharing a laser-cutting cell, with input from quality, maintenance, and logistics.

shared_context.S1: Laser Cell 5 is the only available cell for the released campaign of Order K, containing 320 aluminum brackets, and Order L, containing 180 stainless enclosures.
shared_context.S2: Both customer orders are released for production, and the campaign sequence must be frozen before the next shift begins.
shared_context.S3: Changing material families on Laser Cell 5 creates setup loss, so the normal planning preference is to run one material family completely before changing to the other.
shared_context.S4: During the daily campaign-freeze meeting, Elena routinely takes a report from quality, maintenance, and logistics before signing the final production plan.

PF1.text: The customer control plan for Order L requires dimensional scanning of exactly the first 30 stainless enclosures before the remaining units can be released; Ravi confirmed this in the current customer quality file, but the requirement has not yet been added to the internal routing.

PF2.text: The assist-gas regulator on Laser Cell 5 is outside its stable range for the stainless-steel thickness used by Order L; Marta's maintenance check found that replacing it before the stainless run will take exactly 2 hours, but she has not yet opened the maintenance work order.

PF3.text: The carrier for Order L confirmed a Friday 11:00 pickup and requires all 180 enclosures staged by exactly Friday 10:00; Jonas received the confirmation by email this morning, but the appointment has not yet been entered in the shipping board.

acceptance_conditions: Order L must run before Order K to meet its confirmed carrier pickup.
The assist-gas regulator must be replaced before the stainless run, with exactly 2 hours of downtime.
Exactly 30 units of Order L must receive dimensional scanning before the remaining units are released.
Dimensional scanning must be explicitly required in the final plan.
All 180 units of Order L must be staged by exactly Friday 10:00.
The final plan must contain commitments for the regulator replacement, dimensional scanning, and carrier staging.
Ravi's customer quality-file finding must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C6: any(c.get('type') == 'regulator_replacement' for c in commitments) and any(c.get('type') == 'dimensional_scanning' for c in commitments) and any(c.get('type') == 'carrier_staging' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The customer quality file changes the inspection plan from ordinary sampling to mandatory dimensional scanning of exactly 30 Order L units before release.
The maintenance finding changes the stainless-run plan from no specified outage to an exact 2-hour regulator replacement and regulator-replacement commitment.
The carrier confirmation changes the sequence to Order L before Order K and sets the exact staging requirement of all 180 units by Friday 10:00.
